mission: Build a fractal Google Maps of law for Swiss Federal Supreme Court case law from 2000 onward plus user-imported corpora, beating simple semantic-map baselines in legal usefulness.

corpus.question: Scale the canonical TF-2000+ acquisition/normalization pipeline from current 1,577 decisions (1000 slice + 250 yearly core 2020-2024) to full coverage (2000-2024) via OpenCaseLaw bulk ingestion. Implement robust user corpus import with schema validation and map artifact persistence.

legal-distance.question: CRITICAL PIVOT: (1) REPRODUCE center_projected representation (the ONLY v2 representation passing BOTH adversarial language dominance <0.85 AND jurist pairwise preference >0.5) and validate on full v1+v2 benchmark suite; (2) Scale test: validate legal_cited_decisions_only and hybrid modes on expanded slice (1,200 decisions) USING center_projected as baseline; (3) Legal embeddings: test Isaacus/Legal-BERT for multilingual invariance of legal signals — RE-RUN on center_projected baseline (v5 results on debiased_citation_blended are superseded for multilingual use); (4) Citation role modeling: distinguish/follow/overrule roles vs simple citation lists; (5) Jurist pairwise evaluation of hybrid map modes vs center_projected baseline; (6) Benchmark refinement: replace duplicate/non-discriminating benchmarks with jurist-usefulness proxies.

fractal-map.question: Productize the validated multi-resolution hierarchical Leiden map (nesting=1.0, purity=0.949, zoom_coherence 59.2% improvement rate): expose resolution ladder, cluster metadata, legal coherence at each zoom level in product; integrate as default map structure with legal-distance selectable modes. NOTE: Current product uses hierarchical_leiden on debiased_citation_blended embeddings; must REPRODUCE hierarchical_leiden on center_projected embeddings as new default input.

evaluation.question: Define and execute v3: Validate legal-distance unsupervised signal ablation results and frontier_metric_learning_jurivoc supervised metric learning results on expanded slice (1,200 decisions) using adversarial benchmarks (language dominance, jurist pairwise, Jurivoc hierarchy alignment, scale stability, boilerplate resistance). center_projected is the default reference representation to beat. Freeze evaluation harness with global seed.

product.question: Complete vertical slice integration: persist user-imported map artifacts, add map export, ADOPT center_projected as DEFAULT map mode (replacing debiased_citation_blended), integrate legal-distance signals (legal_cited_decisions_only, hybrid α=0.3, hybrid α=0.5, legal_issues_outcomes, erwaegungen+citations, sachverhalt_tfidf, norm_embeddings) as selectable map modes alongside hierarchical_leiden default, harden corpus-to-map pipeline for TF base map plus user imports.

director_note: EVIDENCE-DRIVEN UPDATE RUN_33134366967. Core change from v3: center_projected is now the authoritative reference representation per Evaluation v2 ACCEPTED evidence.
